The review pools distinct TRP-agent trials on neurogenic dysphagia. Reference 15 is a post-stroke black pepper oil inhalation trial. Reference 22 is the distinct clinical menthol crossover. Table 1 uses 34 oil and 33 odorless follow-up participants from the black pepper trial. The original randomized 35 per arm including lavender. The class estimate does not isolate cracked pepper, ingested food, pain, or a Parkinson pepper subgroup. The menthol procedure was direct pharyngeal administration. There is no dried date pain result.
